status: INFERRED sensitivity model only; no synthesis or silicon energy measured
proof_inferred: q=(y>>9)&15 depends only on y modulo 8192. Reduction modulo 8192 commutes with every integer multiply/add; discarded high carries cannot alter bits 9..12.
range_note: 19 signed bits miss the attainable positive endpoint +262144; the full mathematical sum needs 20. The consensus nibble needs only 13 residue bits.
limitations: NAND-equivalent counts are assumed proxies, not library mapping.
Gate area does not determine dynamic energy: switching, gating, capacitance, voltage and routing are unresolved.
SRAM/HBM, bank reload, SHAKE, expansion, quantization, fold and control are common system costs excluded here.
Electronic ASICs can exploit exact narrow residue arithmetic. GPU INT32 and analog photonic comparisons need mapped end-to-end evidence.
This is the owner's allowed exact-arithmetic hardware-economics category, not a work-omitting shortcut.
